text: Eaton Corporation plc has no controlling or state shareholder; its largest shareholders are The Vanguard Group (9.43%) and BlackRock (7.04%) -- purely private/institutional capital.

source.name: Eaton Corp plc DEF 14A 2026 (SEC)
source.quote: Set forth below is certain information concerning persons who are known by us to have reported owning beneficially more than 5% of our ordinary shares.
